silhouette.reason: Bigger octagonal turret with team roof, shorter gun with brake, chevron prow, side stowage boxes breaking the hull line: reads as a light tank from every view.
fixes: a stowage basket on the turret rear so the turret outline is not one block

proportions.reason: 6.1 x 3.1 x 3.2 m, gun now ~0.6 of hull length, turret scaled up for the RTS read.
fixes: road wheels ~5% bigger so they fill the track run

materials.reason: Bolts, track links and fittings now sit on a brushed steel strip and catch small specular highlights (hero.png glacis bolts, sheet FRONT tracks read as light steel), and the bone enamel has a slightly glossier film; rubber tyres, brass hubs and amber lamps stay distinct, team-roof chips stay ragged. The gun sleeve lost its dark band and now matches the barrel, so the gun is one flat grey, and the large bone plates are still clean flat paint.
fixes: give the gun sleeve/mantlet a darker or rougher finish than the barrel so the gun keeps value breakup
a few edge-biased chips and subtle roughness variation on the large bone hull plates

detail.reason: Bolt rows on glacis and turret edges, weld seams, side stowage, spare links, hatch, periscope, antenna, grille, tool rack.
fixes: a tow cable on the rear plate
track guide horns and sprocket teeth

wear.reason: Black exhaust soot fans over the rear plate (sheet 3/4 REAR, TOP), rusty mud climbs the tracks and lower hull, the team roof and deck chevrons are chipped raggedly to the undercoat and fine scratches mark the turret sides (hero.png): the vehicle has a history from every angle.
fixes: dust in the deck recesses round the turret ring
chips on the bone hull edges (glacis, fender lips)

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 now shows six road-wheel discs per side inside an open track, turret, team roof and gun: the side outline holds at the switch.
fixes: keep the headlamp dots at LOD2

technical.reason: QA PASS: 30.5k / 8.1k / 590 tris, 23 / 9 / 7 draws. LOD0 down from 37.5k with 20-sided wheels and coarser wear cells, but LOD0 still costs 23 draws for an RTS unit.
fixes: merge the static road-wheel pivots into one draw per side at LOD0 as well
LOD0 toward ~20k for an RTS unit
